metadata.remarks: Cloud Networking defines the trust properties required to enforce segmentation, limit exposure, and control connectivity within cloud environments. This pattern recognizes that cloud networks are software-defined and provider-managed, requiring explicit governance to prevent unintended access and lateral movement.

components.title: Cloud Network Segmentation
components.description: Separates cloud workloads into distinct network zones with controlled connectivity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Network segmentation limits unintended communication between cloud resources.

components.title: Cloud Exposure Management
components.description: Controls which cloud resources are exposed to external or public networks.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cloud network exposure is explicitly managed to prevent unintended access.

components.title: Cloud Private Connectivity
components.description: Supports private and controlled connectivity between cloud resources and trusted networks.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Private connectivity mechanisms reduce exposure to untrusted networks.
